title: Customer Assurance Workbench and Priority Allocator
creator: Sophie Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a steady stream of security/compliance asks (SOC2/ISO attestations, HIPAA questions, GDPR/DPA clauses, lengthy vendor questionnaires). Right now these arrive across email, Zendesk, and Sales notes; PM/Support do ad-hoc triage, engineering gets paged for clarifications, and evidence assembly is manual. This increases SLA variance, blocks deals, and creates audit risk.

Goal: Build a lightweight Product-managed 'Assurance Workbench' that centralizes requests, auto-classifies ask type and urgency, surfaces required evidence templates by category (SOC2 controls, data residency, DPA clauses, HIPAA handling), and computes a priority score (priority allocator) for routing to the right lane: self-serve docs, Solutions/SE, Security review, or Eng feature/bug backlog. The solution should reduce average triage-to-response time for medium/high requests from ~7 business days to <=2 business days and provide a consistent evidence bundling output for customers.

Approach summary: 1) Create a single intake endpoint (API + lightweight UI) for Security/Compliance asks and integrate with Zendesk and Sales CRM to backfill past tickets. 2) Implement an auto-classifier (rule + lightweight LLM assist) that tags request type (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaire) and estimates complexity and customer tier. 3) Define priority allocator scoring: customer_tier, request_type, legal_deadline, renewal/contract_risk, previous_evidence_exists, automated_answer_confidence. 4) Map priority lanes to outcomes and SLAs and wire routing: docs/self-serve (P3), Solutions/SE review (P2), Security/Escalation + Eng (P1). 5) Provide evidence bundle generator: templates + checklist per control + links to product features (hosting mode, dedicated/private options) and an audit-ready export (PDF + manifest). 6) Instrument metrics in Console: time-to-triage, time-to-first-response, lane conversion, evidence reuse rate.

Boundaries & trade-offs: we will not build a full legal QA assistant in scope—initial classifier is hybrid rules + curated LLM prompts. Engineering investment limited to providing APIs and evidence artifacts; full automation of questionnaire completion is out of scope for this cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Single intake endpoint accepting security/compliance asks with Zendesk + CRM integrations active
Automated classifier tags >= 85% of incoming requests to correct category in a 2-week validation set
Priority allocator produces a deterministic score and maps to lanes with documented SLA per lane
Evidence bundle generator can produce a control-specific checklist and an exportable ZIP (PDF + manifest) for at least SOC2, GDPR/DPA, and HIPAA templates
Console dashboard shows time-to-triage and time-to-first-response and is updated hourly
SLA target: median time-to-first-response for P1 requests <= 2 business days in first 30 days after launch
tasks: Design intake schema and minimal UI wireframe (UX) and review with Support and Sales
Build intake API and Zendesk webhook connector (ENG)
Develop classifier ruleset and LLM prompt set; assemble labeled training validation set (PM + Security)
Define priority scoring rubric and implement scoring service (PM + ENG)
Create evidence templates and control checklists for SOC2, GDPR/DPA, HIPAA, ISO with Security SME
Implement evidence bundle exporter and link back to product documentation for Hosted/Dedicated/Private options
Instrument Console metrics and create dashboard panels (time-to-triage, lane distribution, evidence reuse)
Pilot with top 3 enterprise customers and gather feedback; iterate on scoring and templates
Create runbook for Solutions/SE and Security escalations; document routing and expected SLAs
Ship beta with feature flag and monitor KPIs for 30 days, then propose GA rollout plan

risks: Classifier may underperform on vendor questionnaires with custom formats — mitigation: manual review queue and conservative scoring
Evidence templates may reveal gaps that require engineering changes (e.g., crypto KMS details) — mitigation: route to Eng backlog and provide customer-facing temporary guidance
Legal/Privacy signoff timelines could delay pilot — mitigation: early engagement and weekly legal sync
Over-automation risk: aggressive automated answers could provide incorrect commitments — mitigation: require human approval for P1 lane outputs
